name: Agnes Image Flash
description: Public YLCraft connector preset for Agnes Image 2.1/2.0 Flash text-to-image and image-to-image. Add your own API key after import.

connectors.name: Agnes Image 2.1 Flash
connectors.description: Agnes Image 2.1 Flash 文生图/图生图/多图合成，同步返回图片 URL（data[0].url）。图生图时把参考图数组写入 extra_body.image；支持通过素材库/手动 URL 传入参考图。尺寸档位用 size(1K~4K)，比例用独立 ratio 字段。
connectors.request_template: {"model":"{{ model }}","prompt":"{{ prompt }}","size":"{{ size }}"{% if ratio %},"ratio":"{{ ratio }}"{% endif %},"extra_body":{"response_format":"url"}}
